title: View and Manage AP/AR Data ON allows paying several invoices at once from the Unpaid Invoices tab
custom_preconds:
1. A user has a role with Invoicing & payments View and Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data ON.
  2. A customer has several unpaid invoices.
custom_steps:
1. Open the customer and click the Unpaid Invoices tab.
  2. Find the option to pay several invoices at once (select multiple, then Pay).
  3. Make a payment across several invoices.
custom_expected: The pay-several-at-once option is available and the payment goes through.
evidence: Bulk payment needs live UI + payment (create-customer-payment 500s intermittently per prior run).
